note: Fixed-grid layout of record for this rig's sheets, read from the sheets BY EYE (Read tool, 2026-09-25) and snapped to the measured empty gutters. The model kept each requested grid but drifted from the nominal lines (e.g. the chief eye row reaches y 289, past the nominal 256; the chief moustache_grin crosses x 768), so every boundary is placed in the middle of the transparent gutter nearest the nominal line. Labels follow the prompt order (source_prompt) row-major. build_parts/cut_sheets.py cuts ONLY these rectangles: a component belongs to the cell holding its centroid, then the cell's rule decides what is kept. No clustering.
coordinates: sheet pixels, x right / y down, [start, end)

rules.eyes: keep BOTH eyes: the two largest components that are not brows; a brow is a solid dark stroke (>= 85 % dark ink, < 2 % white) with another component below it overlapping >= 30 % of the narrower width. Brows are dropped here (brow pieces come only from the brow row).
rules.brows: keep the two largest components (the brow pair)
rules.mouth: keep the mouth only: the largest component plus its own creases (solid ink strokes within 30 px of it and under 15 % of its area: corner dimples, a lip arc); anything else in the cell is dropped and listed under `dropped` in registration.json
rules.hand: keep the whole hand: every component in the cell
rules.plate: keep the plate: the largest component plus any component inside its box
rules.whole: keep every component in the cell
rules.figure: keep the largest component whose centroid lies in the cell; the figure may overhang the cell rectangle (the three poses interlock in x), and it is cut by its own component mask so no neighbour pixel is taken

eyes.how: fit of eyes_open's near eye on the master (overlay reviewed)

brows.how: width of the master's near brow vs brows_neutral's near brow

mouth.how: fit and width of mouth_closed on the master smile (0.30 / 0.34, overlay reviewed)

ears.how: fit of ear_right (the image-left, near ear; 'ear_left' in r2) on the master's image-left ear (0.47, overlay reviewed; foreshortened)

hands.how: r2.1 (verifier: 0.45 read 25-30 % small): pink-area ratio 0.63 (hand_r_open vs arm_right's hand); side by side at 0.45 / 0.55 / 0.60 / 0.65 / 0.70 the palm, finger length and navy cuff match arm_right's and arm_left's own hands at 0.60 (reviewed by eye; the verifier's cuff-width estimate was 0.58-0.62). r2 used 0.45

cards.how: no counterpart on the master: equal to the hands (the pinch hand holds the card); follows the r2.1 hand scale 0.60 (r2: 0.45)

hose.how: so the hose (91 px thick on the sheet) passes the grip tunnel (48 px equivalent diameter on hand_r_grip / hand_l_grip at sheet scale, 29 px on the canvas at the hand scale 0.60): 0.60 x 48 / 91 = 0.316 (r2: 0.237 from the old hand scale 0.45)

scales_note: scale_to_canvas per FAMILY of pieces (eyes, brows, mouths, ears, ...): the model drew each row at its own size, so one scale per sheet (r1) was wrong by up to 2x; each family is measured on one reference piece against its counterpart on the master (overlay reviewed) or set by eye where no counterpart is visible
